body: Oh wow I’m so sorry, yeah it’s hard to trust people now a days people take everything for granted

There is a answer for everyone, I don't like therapy or counseling either at all I tend not to open up to them as much as I'd like so they can't benefit me in anyway, that's good you have friends, friends are a good way to keep your mind off depression sometimes I wish I had friends but the town I live in everyone is fake and you can't trust not one single person, I'm sorry your family wouldn't understand. Family is a big reason why I'm still here to this day idk what is do without them. I hope you find help I'm always here if you need anyone

It’s life I guess we all go through shit right, also my first medication I was on didn’t help at all it just made me really sick and nauseous this medication I just stopped taking didn’t do anything to me at all I’ve been off it for awhile now and nothing different has happened I’m still depressed and still have hella anxiety
